meta.histology: Documented diagnosis review of all registered TCGA-ESCA and TCGA-PAAD cases using published pathology tables and original GDC pathology reports; not a new expert slide review.
meta.scope: Metadata review of excluded assay aliquots carrying patient annotations, against live GDC case annotations. Review categories are not additional exclusions.

cohorts.label: Confirmed oesophageal squamous cell carcinoma
cohorts.exception: Approved smaller cohort: below both the 150-patient total and the 100-patient paired thresholds of the general screen.
cohorts.definition: TCGA-ESCA patients classified as oesophageal squamous cell carcinoma in the TCGA oesophageal study's Supplementary Table 1, with retained primary-tumour assays after quality exclusions. Squamous carcinomas labelled only in GDC metadata are kept outside the cohort as provisional.

cohorts.label: Confirmed pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
cohorts.exception: Proposed cohort one patient below the general 150-patient total threshold; the paired threshold is met. The general screen is unchanged.
cohorts.definition: TCGA-PAAD patients with retained primary-tumour assays whose diagnosis is ductal adenocarcinoma in the TCGA pancreatic study's pathology review table (Histological type by RHH), plus patients absent from that table whose original GDC pathology report confirms invasive pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. Membership is an explicit patient list, not a morphology-code filter.

cohorts.label: Confirmed PDAC, sensitivity subset
cohorts.definition: The PDAC cohort without the one patient whose pathology report describes a focal squamous component (TCGA-L1-A7W4).
